channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Decisivo no RJ, eleitorado do interior cresce e vê o da capital diminuir
item.description: The electorate in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state has grown over the past four years, while the metropolitan region's electorate has declined, according to TSE data. This trend underscores the strategic importance of the interior in statewide elections, as every governor elected since 2002 has won in the interior. Historically, candidates aiming to win in 2026 will need to consolidate support in interior cities.

item.title: PT abre mão de candidaturas próprias para governador em 14 estados para fortalecer alianças
item.description: The PT has decided to forgo its own gubernatorial candidacies in 14 states in 2026 to strengthen alliances with local parties, supporting candidates such as Juliana Brizola in Rio Grande do Sul and Eduardo Paes in Rio de Janeiro. In 12 other states, the party will maintain its own gubernatorial candidates, while allies will occupy vice-governor and Senate seats. The strategy aims to consolidate national support for Lula’s 2026 re-election, even if it means yielding state-level electoral space.

item.title: Michelle quer derrota de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz especialista
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro desires the defeat of her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, in the 2026 presidential election to consolidate her own political project for 2030, according to sociologist Rudá Ricci. This strategy is part of a reorganization of the Bolsonarist camp due to Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility and Eduardo Bolsonaro's self-exile in the U.S., with Michelle building alliances with Damares Alves and Celina Leão to position herself as the family's heir.

item.title: PoderDataCast: convenções de PT e Missão devem ser maiores que a do PL
item.description: Rudá Ricci, president of the Cultiva Institute, states that the PT and Missão conventions, scheduled for the final days of the electoral calendar (until August 5), should be larger and more impactful than those of other parties, as they allow observing opponents and generating greater media repercussion. He notes that the PL convention, held on July 25, had limited effect due to the distraction caused by Javier Milei's presence. Ricci expects Lula (PT) and Renan Santos (Missão) to organize spectacular events to maximize visibility and viral potential on social media.

item.title: Medidas de crédito somam R$ 333 bilhões em 2026
item.description: President Lula's government launched or expanded credit programs totaling R$ 332.8 billion in 2026 to stimulate the economy during an election year. The initiatives cover financing for industry, housing, workers, airlines, rural producers, and small businesses. This credit expansion contrasts with the Central Bank's restrictive monetary policy, which aims to cool demand and reduce inflation, with the Selic rate at 14.25%, creating a potential conflict between fiscal stimulus and monetary tightening.

item.title: Lula acerta ou erra?
item.description: Lula stated that if his eldest son, Lulinha, had done something wrong, he would not offer his help, sparking debate about a father's role when his children make mistakes. A poll of 766 readers showed that 95.2% agreed with Lula's stance, considering it correct, while only 4.8% believed a good father should always help his son regardless of the error.

item.title: Manchester City x Inter de Milão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Manchester City and Inter Milan will face off on Saturday, August 1st, at 8:30 AM Brasília time, at Kai Tak Sports Park in Hong Kong, in a pre-season friendly. The match marks Enzo Maresca’s debut as Manchester City manager following Pep Guardiola’s departure, with key players like Haaland, Rodri, and Doku absent due to vacation, injury, or international duties. Inter Milan, led by Cristian Chivu and coming off as Serie A champions, fields a mix of experienced starters and youth, reprising the 2023 Champions League final.

item.title: Líder de Lula amplia patrimônio em R$ 1,68 milhão em quatro anos
item.description: The leader of Lula's government in the Chamber of Deputies, Paulo Pimenta (PT-RS), declared assets worth R$ 1.8 million in 2026, nearly ten times the R$ 192,800 reported in 2022. The increase is mainly attributed to the inclusion of 50% of a Brasília residential property (R$ 815 thousand), plus a 2022 Toyota Hilux, financial investments, and credits. Pimenta stated the figures reflect an update to the Federal Revenue and include assets previously declared by his wife.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: The Aroeira cartoon criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro, portraying him as a 'fool' according to Tereza Cristina and the Progressistas, reflecting internal tensions within the Brazilian right. It also mentions his journey as a candidate without alliances and includes articles on ecology and Argentina, indicating a focus on political and ideological debates.

item.title: A questão judaica e a divisão entre nomes conhecidos da esquerda brasileira
item.description: Cid Benjamin, a left-wing journalist and activist, is facing a defamation lawsuit after suggesting that Jewish PT figures Senator Jaques Wagner and Lula's aide Clara Ant acted as 'unofficial spokespersons for Israel'. The hearing will take place at Rio de Janeiro's 27th Criminal Court on Tuesday, the 4th. The case highlights internal divisions within Brazil's left regarding stances on Israel and the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é feito de bobo por Tereza Cristina e o Progressistas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced another setback in his search for a vice-presidential running mate after announcing an alleged agreement with Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), which was promptly denied by the Progressistas party, reaffirming its national neutrality. The incident exposed his political isolation, eroding support in key sectors like Faria Lima and agribusiness, and highlighted his lack of party coordination, as noted by Ricardo Noblat. The situation underscores Flávio’s difficulties in building a competitive ticket for 2026.

item.title: Arrecadação de recursos: a principal esperança do PL com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: PL leaders express frustration with Flávio Bolsonaro, who failed to meet expectations of being a more pragmatic and manageable candidate compared to his father, Jair Bolsonaro. They had hoped he would be easier to work with for the 2026 presidential campaign, but now say they were mistaken about his demeanor and approach. Internal tensions are rising as the election draws nearer.

item.title: O erro de Flávio Bolsonaro que inviabilizou Tereza Cristina como vice, segundo aliados
item.description: The negotiations for Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) to be the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) failed due to the PP party’s neutrality stance, led by its president Ciro Nogueira. However, allies claim the decisive factor was Flávio’s delay in personally approaching the senator, which weakened the talks. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Jingle de Renan é resposta a “Lula lá” e se chama “A vingança do povo”
item.description: Renan Santos, pré-candidate of the Missão party for president, will unveil the jingle 'A Vingança do Povo' as a response to the 1989 'Lula Lá' anthem, with a chorus framing the vote for number 14 as popular revenge. The event will also feature ten government goals, including reducing homicides to no more than 10,000 per year and achieving literacy for nine out of ten children, alongside a speech by Kim Kataguiri on state reform and presentations of state candidates and vice-presidential nominee Aroldo Medina.

item.title: Bancada da educação no Congresso quer mudanças no Enem já em 2027 após reforma do Novo Ensino Médio; saiba quais
item.description: The Mixed Parliamentary Front for Education, led by Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), proposes adapting the Enem to the New High School by 2027 — one year earlier than planned — including the assessment of formative itineraries. However, Inep states that changes will be open for public debate by the end of 2026 for implementation in 2028, as required by the National Education Council, emphasizing that basic general education should remain the exam’s focus. President Lula had vetoed the inclusion of itineraries in the Enem during the 2024 sanction of the New High School reform.

item.title: Veto do PP amplia reveses de Flávio Bolsonaro na busca por vice e consolida afastamento do Centrão
item.description: The PP blocked Tereza Cristina (MS) from joining Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket, worsening the senator's setbacks in finding a running mate and deepening the Centrão's withdrawal from his presidential campaign. The Brazil Union federation is also moving toward neutrality, while Republicans signal they will take the same stance at their national convention next Tuesday.

item.title: Inquérito de Lulinha eleva atrito entre PF e Mendonça, relator de casos de impacto antes das eleições
item.description: The opening of an investigation against Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) by the Federal Police created tension with Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, after the PGR concluded the case is unrelated to Operation Sem Desconto, rejecting Mendonça’s jurisdictional claim. Despite this, an electronic random draw assigned Mendonça as rapporteur, heightening tensions amid a politically charged environment with potential electoral implications. The probe alleges influence peddling and corruption involving lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS'.

item.title: Comprador da Naskar desviou R$ 60 milhões de empresa da família de Zema
item.description: Douglas Azara, the buyer of fintech Naskar, was identified as the leader of a scheme that diverted R$60 million from Zema Financeira, owned by the family of former Minas Gerais governor and 2026 presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo), between November and December 2025. The funds were transferred to his company, Jabuti Capital, following a cyberattack that stole R$75 million from the Zema Group. Azara fled to Dubai in July 2025 and remains subject to an outstanding preventive arrest warrant.

item.title: Tarcísio chega à convenção em meio a cálculo sobre palanques nacionais
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will be officially nominated for re-election in São Paulo on Saturday (August 1st) at the Republicans' state convention in Ibirapuera Gymnasium. The party aims to give the event a national character, positioning Tarcísio as the main figure, while carefully managing the presence of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to avoid overshadowing the governor. Tarcísio plans to maintain a 'safe distance' from Flávio and other national figures like Ronaldo Caiado to protect his high approval ratings and avoid controversies.

item.title: Filho de brasileiros, ex-deputado americano é multado em R$ 178 mil por usar discurso presidencial para fazer apostas
item.description: Former Republican congressman George Santos, son of Brazilians, was fined $35,000 (R$178,000) by the CFTC for manipulating the Kalshi prediction market using non-public information about his attendance at Trump’s State of the Union address. Santos placed conflicting bets and misled other traders via social media posts to profit from market movements, earning over $17,500. He was ordered to disgorge profits, pay a civil penalty, and is barred from prediction markets for three years.

item.title: Missão faz congresso em SP antes de determinar candidato ao governo
item.description: The Free Brazil Movement (MBL), now a political party called Missão, will hold its first congress in São Paulo this Saturday (August 1) to define its electoral strategy. The event precedes a decision on the party’s candidate for governor of São Paulo, scheduled for Wednesday (August 5), with Renan Santos as the party’s presidential pre-candidate. Although Arthur do Val is ineligible and attempting to reverse the decision in the STJ, and Kim Kataguiri is focusing on federal re-election to secure party fund access, Missão’s leadership indicates that none of the party’s main figures in the state will run for governor.

item.title: Careca do INSS foi 5 vezes à pasta de atual assessor de Lula
item.description: Lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS,' stated he made five visits to the Health Ministry’s executive secretariat between 2024 and 2025, then led by Swedenberger Barbosa (Berger), now chief of staff in Lula’s Personal Office. Berger is a long-time PT figure with close ties to Lula and his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), who is under PF investigation for corruption and influence peddling. The visits relate to efforts to expand medicinal cannabis businesses, involving Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha, and include messages indicating Berger had already provided guidance.

item.title: Contas públicas atestam fracasso do arcabouço fiscal
item.description: The Central Bank released data showing the failure of Brazil's fiscal framework, indicating deterioration in public accounts and an imminent risk of stagflation. The article attributes this situation to the alleged fiscal irresponsibility of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, suggesting the country is heading toward a severe economic crisis. The piece is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Mendonça faz bem em autorizar PF a investigar suspeitas contra Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, on suspicions of influence peddling and corruption in two cases: SUS product supply and a Dataprev contract. Lulinha denies the allegations, but the investigation will examine whether he improperly used his ties to the Planalto Palace. The decision was described as sensible by the article's author.

item.title: Bolsonarismo põe disputa eleitoral sob estresse democrático
item.description: Bolsonarism keeps the 2026 electoral dispute under democratic stress, repeating patterns of institutional and electoral system attacks seen in 2022. The narrative includes unfounded allegations against electronic voting machines and attempts to suppress voting, such as the PRF operation in the Northeast. Despite Bolsonaro's ineligibility and conviction for coup attempt, the movement continues to shape the political landscape.

item.title: Bolsonarismo é agora ameaça existencial a Moraes
item.description: State polls show the right and center-right could win 40 of 81 Senate seats in 2026, nearing an absolute majority. Valdemar Costa Neto of the PL projects electing 20 new senators, adding to eight current ones to form a bloc of 28, needing only 13 center-right allies to elect the Senate president — who holds the power to initiate impeachment against STF ministers. The article frames bolsonarism as an existential threat to Alexandre de Moraes in this context.

item.title: Quaest: veja os índices de aprovação e desaprovação dos governos de 10 estados
item.description: The Quaest July 2026 poll shows relative stability in governor approval ratings across 10 states, except in Rio de Janeiro, where former governor Cláudio Castro has more disapproval than approval (a net negative of 26 points). Ronaldo Caiado (União) leads in Goiás with 87% approval, while Ratinho Júnior (PSD) in Paraná has 81% and Raquel Lyra (PSDB) in Pernambuco rose to 68% approval, the largest increase among those surveyed.

item.title: Lula e Renan Santos realizam convenções partidárias neste final de semana; entenda como vai funcionar
item.description: Lula (PT) and Renan Santos (Missão) hold party conventions in São Paulo this weekend to formalize their 2026 presidential candidacies. Lula will seek re-election with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate, while Renan run debut. Conventions, held between July 20 and August 5, are required for candidate registration with the Electoral Justice by August 15.

item.title: Lula e Milei, Bolsonaro e Fernández: como fica a relação de Brasil e Argentina com presidentes que se atacam
item.description: Despite exchanges of insults between Lula and Milei and a history of tensions between Bolsonaro and Fernández, Brazil-Argentina relations maintain strategic partnerships in trade and Mercosur, as state interests prevail over personal presidential disagreements. Experts say economic integration prevents political conflicts from becoming institutional ruptures, even with public criticisms and diplomatic gestures of dissatisfaction.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Quando será primeiro e segundo turno das eleições?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections will take place in two rounds: the first on October 4 and the second, if needed, on October 25. In the first round, voters will elect state and district deputies, federal deputies, senators, governors, and the president. The second round applies only to presidential and gubernatorial elections when no candidate achieves an absolute majority (50% plus one) of valid votes in the first round.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido do PL e mantém no ar vídeo de Lula com 10 dedos
item.description: The Ceará Electoral Court rejected the PL’s request to remove an Instagram video showing Lula with 10 fingers, ruling there was no direct vote solicitation nor proven irregular use of AI. The decision states that mentioning a pre-candidacy, praising personal qualities, and requesting political support are allowed absent a direct vote request, and that the visual effects are conventional editing techniques, not requiring an AI disclaimer.

item.title: Zema ironiza Lulinha em novo episódio de “Os Intocáveis”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) released a new episode of his AI-generated satirical series 'Os Intocáveis', mocking the investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over alleged influence trafficking in the medicinal cannabis market. The video portrays Lula as more concerned about the electoral impact of the probe than the investigation itself, referencing past cases like the Correios CPI and Banco Master, and shows Flávio Dino declining to interfere, citing the case's assignment to Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Acre: coligação confirma Tião Bocalom ao governo e Velloso ao Senado
item.description: The Produzir para Empregar coalition, formed by PSDB, Cidadania and Solidariedade, officially launched Tião Bocalom’s gubernatorial bid and Eduardo Velloso’s Senate campaign in Acre. The convention in Rio Branco also named sargento Adonis as Bocalom’s running mate. Bocalom, a former Rio Branco mayor and Bolsonaro ally, polls third with 17% voter intent, while Velloso, an ophthalmologist and former supporter of Governor Mailza Assis, seeks his first Senate term.

item.title: Em novo lapso, Lula diz não ter certeza de que vai ganhar eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) made another gaffe at the PT Convention in Ceará on July 31, 2026, stating he 'does not have certainty that we will win the elections in this country,' raising concerns about his bid for an unprecedented fourth term at age 85. Earlier that day, he said Cearenses have 'big heads due to their intelligence,' sparking debate over whether the remark was offensive or complimentary.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro patina em alianças e conta com Tarcísio para último apelo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to form political alliances, with PP, União Brasil, Republicans, and Podemos refusing or likely rejecting partnership. This leaves the PL senator as the main opposition candidate to Lula, but isolated, without support from major parties beyond his own.

item.title: Mendonça, quem compõe a polícia clandestina que investiga o DG da PF?
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça has opened a second inquiry against Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, over alleged obstruction of justice in an INSS case. The author criticizes the lack of impartiality, as Mendonça acts as investigator, judge, and external controller of the PF, forming what is described as a 'clandestine police' linked to the Supreme Court. The piece notes the investigation unfolds amid electoral tensions and questions the silence of the AGU and Justice Ministry in the face of what it sees as an abuse of power.

item.title: “Está posto”, diz Tereza Cristina sobre fim da articulação para vice de Flávio
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated she respects the Progressistas party's decision to remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election, ending negotiations to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate. She ruled out an independent candidacy and affirmed she will continue supporting Bolsonaro's campaign despite the collapsed talks. The PP announced, after consulting state directories, that it chose neutrality and will not convene a national convention to define presidential support.

item.title: 'Enquanto eu viver, a extrema-direita não voltará a governar este país', diz Lula em convenção do PT no Ceará
item.description: Lula stated that as long as he lives, the far-right will not return to govern Brazil, downplaying the support of Trump and Milei for the opposition and emphasizing that his only desired help comes from the Brazilian people to preserve democracy. He also endorsed Cid Gomes for Senate and Gabriella Aguiar as vice-governor of Ceará, stressing the need to renew the Senate, which he described as 'half rotten'.

item.title: Gayer questiona governo sobre vistos negados a representantes dos EUA
item.description: Federal Deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) requested explanations from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding the denial of diplomatic visas to U.S. officials Riley M. Barnes and Samuel D. Samson, who intended to meet with Brazilian electoral authorities. The request seeks clarification on the legal and administrative basis for the decision, as well as whether other federal entities such as the Presidency, Abin, and the Federal Police were involved in the assessment. The visa denial came one day before Flávio Bolsonaro raised concerns about electronic voting machine security at an event with ambassadors, sparking fears of foreign influence on the election process.

item.title: ‘Se quiser vir Trump, que venha. Se quiser vir Milei, que venha. Não quero ajuda de fora’, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated he does not want foreign interference in Brazil's elections, challenging Donald Trump and Javier Milei to intervene but insisting he only seeks support from the Brazilian people to preserve democracy. He also emphasized the need to invest in technical and scientific education to compete with China and responded to Milei's insults, who called him a 'convict' and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes a 'trash bald'.

item.title: Lula cita Trump e Milei e diz não querer "ajuda de fora" na eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva rejected foreign support for his 2026 re-election bid, stating that Donald Trump and Javier Milei may aid his opponents but will lose the election. He emphasized wanting only the support of the Brazilian people to preserve democracy, responding to recent foreign interference attempts, including Milei’s participation in the PL convention and denied visas for Trump officials. Lula also advocated investing in engineering and math education to compete with China and counter Trump’s 'arrogance'.

item.title: Brasil vai acabar com “arrogância” de Trump, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazilians must invest in AI and mathematics education to compete with China and counter Donald Trump's 'arrogance,' speaking at a PT convention in Ceará. He emphasized that Brazil will not 'bow its head' amid rising trade tensions with the U.S., particularly following the 2026 second tariff round imposing up to 37.5% duties on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Tereza Cristina lamenta fim da articulação para vice após negativa do PP: 'O que foi está posto'
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) confirmed that negotiations for her to become Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate have ended following the PP's public rejection, stating the party will maintain neutrality and that she is not an independent candidate. She reiterated her support for Bolsonaro's campaign and said she respects the party's decision, even while expressing disappointment over the stalemate.

item.title: Com Lula, PT oficializa candidatura de Elmano ao governo do Ceará
item.description: The PT formally nominated Governor Elmano de Freitas for re-election in Ceará during a convention attended by President Lula. Elmano announced Gabriella Aguiar (PSD) as his running mate and highlighted achievements in health, education, and security while mocking opponents. Lula framed the election as a battle between truth and lies, urging voters to support Elmano, Cid Gomes, and PT candidates as part of a unified slate.

item.title: Lulinha protagoniza novo episódio de ‘Os Intocáveis’
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema released the ninth episode of the satirical animation series 'Os Intocáveis', titled 'Son of Lula, Lulinha is', which focuses on Lulinha, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The episode prompted Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes to file a complaint against Zema with the Attorney General's Office (PGR).

item.title: Tebet diz não ter interesse em ser ministra novamente caso Lula se reeleja: 'Já ocupei essa missão'
item.description: Simone Tebet, the PSB Senate candidate for São Paulo, stated she has no interest in becoming a minister again if Lula is re-elected, saying she already fulfilled that role in the current government. She said she delegated the decision on suplências to the party's National Executive and noted that the proposed names are of impeccable reputation. Tebet added that, if elected, she aims to serve eight years in the Federal Senate.

item.title: Com Lula, PT oficializa candidatura de Elmano de Freitas
item.description: The Workers' Party officially nominated Elmano de Freitas for re-election as governor of Ceará, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in attendance. The ticket includes Gabriella Aguiar (PSD) as vice-governor candidate and Senator Cid Gomes (PSB) running for Senate re-election. Despite Elmano's confidence, a Genial/Quaest poll shows Ciro Gomes (PSDB) leading by 10 percentage points.

item.title: Partido Verde oficializa apoio à candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The Green Party (PV) officially endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid for president in 2026 during a virtual national convention on March 31. The party emphasized its commitment to sustainability, social inclusion, and institutional strengthening. Lula's official candidacy will be confirmed only at the Workers' Party (PT) convention on April 2.

item.title: Cearense tem cabeça grande pela quantidade de inteligência, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised Ceara residents, saying they 'have big heads because of the amount of intelligence they have' during a visit to the University Hospital of Ceará in Fortaleza. He emphasized that the Northeast does not need to ask for favors and deserves respect due to the intelligence of its people. This is not the first time Lula has made similar remarks, having previously referred to Minister José Guimarães as 'big-headed from Ceará'.

item.title: Convenção do PSTU lança candidatura de Hertz Dias à Presidência em SP
item.description: The PSTU officially launched Hertz Dias as its presidential candidate at a convention in São Paulo, with Vanessa Portugal as his running mate. The ticket presents itself as a socialist and class-independent alternative to the far-right and the Lula government. The convention also nominated candidates for other offices in São Paulo, including governor, Senate, and state legislature.
